_comment: kl_paper_search.py（今後作成）がSemantic Scholar Graph APIへのクエリ生成に使う設定。カテゴリはCLAUDE.mdのSTAGE1サブジャンル表と対応。weightはSTAGE1でのカテゴリ登場頻度に使う。最低12話公開されるまでは全カテゴリ均等のまま固定し、アナリティクスによる自動調整は行わない（weight_policy参照）。

aging_care.label: 高齢化・介護・自立支援
queries: "socially assistive robot" AND "older adults" AND (RCT OR "randomized controlled trial")
"companion robot" AND loneliness AND trial
("transfer assist robot" OR "mobility assist robot") AND caregiver AND evaluation
"fall detection" AND wearable AND elderly AND trial
dementia AND "social robot" AND (cognitive OR depression) AND trial
"aging in place" AND "smart home" AND independence AND study
"conversational agent" AND "older adults" AND isolation AND trial

home_robot.label: 家庭内ロボット・家事自動化
queries: "household robot" AND "user study" AND task
"domestic robot" AND ("idle time" OR "multi-task")
"cleaning robot" AND (survey OR "user study" OR adoption)
("kitchen robot" OR "cooking robot") AND manipulation AND evaluation
"laundry folding" AND robot AND "success rate"
"whole-body manipulation" AND household AND "real-world" AND evaluation
"home robot" AND (trust OR acceptance) AND survey

medical_support.label: 医療補助技術
medical_support.note: AI/ロボットによる支援技術のみ対象。診断・治療そのものの医学的妥当性を論じる候補はSTAGE2/3で個別に除外判断する（CLAUDE.md参照）。
queries: "AI-assisted rehabilitation" AND stroke AND (trial OR RCT)
"remote patient monitoring" AND wearable AND elderly AND trial
"robotic exoskeleton" AND rehabilitation AND gait AND clinical
"fall prevention" AND wearable AND sensor AND randomized
"assistive technology" AND "activities of daily living" AND evaluation
"AI hearing device" AND clinical AND evaluation

mobility.label: モビリティ・身体拡張
queries: exoskeleton AND gait AND elderly AND (trial OR evaluation)
"wearable robot" AND mobility AND clinical
"powered prosthesis" AND user AND evaluation
"autonomous wheelchair" AND navigation AND "user study"
"soft exoskeleton" AND walking AND energy AND study

work.label: 働き方の変化
queries: "generative AI" AND productivity AND workplace AND ("field experiment" OR randomized)
"AI agent" AND collaboration AND productivity AND experiment
"AI copilot" AND ("call center" OR "customer support") AND performance
"human-AI collaboration" AND workplace AND randomized
"algorithmic management" AND worker AND wellbeing AND study

disaster_safety.label: 防災・安全
queries: "search and rescue robot" AND field AND evaluation
"disaster response robot" AND deployment AND "case study"
"swarm robotics" AND disaster AND field
"autonomous drone" AND disaster AND response AND evaluation

weight_policy.note: 公開エピソードが最低12話に達するまではweightを全カテゴリ均等(1.0)のまま固定する。それ以前にカテゴリ別CTR・完了率の差でweightを調整すると、少数サンプルのノイズに早合点するリスクがある（lamp-whisperのn≈12ルールを踏襲）。12話到達後はkl_analytics_report.py（今後作成）の分析結果を踏まえ、人間が手動でweightと個々のクエリ語彙を見直す。自動での語彙生成・自動weight更新は行わない。
